identity.mission: Create a NOC (Network Operations Center) dashboard that feels like a futuristic command interface, not a generic admin panel.

dashboard_grid.classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 p-4 md:p-6

containers.card: bg-surface border border-border/20 backdrop-blur-md relative overflow-hidden

customization_rules: Remove all default rounded-xl radii, force sharp or rounded-sm edges.
Inputs should have a transparent background with a strong bottom border or full border with low opacity.
Buttons should use the 'Technical' variant: uppercase labels, monospaced font, subtle hover glow.
Tables must use 'compact' density. Reduce padding.
Modals/Dialogs should have a 'glass' backdrop (backdrop-blur-sm) and a glowing border.

specific_overrides.Card: border-border/30 bg-surface/50 backdrop-blur-sm shadow-none hover:border-primary/40 transition-colors
specific_overrides.Button: font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-xs font-bold rounded-none border border-primary/20 hover:bg-primary/10 hover:text-primary
specific_overrides.Input: bg-background/50 border-border/40 focus:border-primary/80 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/30 rounded-none font-mono
specific_overrides.Badge: rounded-none font-mono uppercase text-[10px] tracking-widest border-0

visual_enhancers.scanlines: background: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent, transparent 2px, #000 3px); opacity: 0.05; pointer-events: none;

images.description: Dark server room with blue lights, suitable for login or empty states

universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a 'Scanline' overlay component for the global app layout to give it that retro-monitor feel (opacity 0.02).
For the Dashboard, use a Bento Grid layout with 'Overview' taking 2x2, 'Active Alerts' 1x2, and 'Device Status' filling the rest.
Ensure high contrast for all text. The background is very dark, so text must be very light.
Add a 'ping' animation (expanding circle) to the status indicators.
